description: This file contains the InvestorAccountingHelper class which provides utility methods for handling accounting journal entries related to investors, including creating debit/credit entries, checking for branch closures, and retrieving account mappings within the Fineract investment module.

classes.name: InvestorAccountingHelper
classes.description: A helper service class for managing investor-related accounting journal entries, including creation, validation, and retrieval of relevant accounts and closures.

methods.name: checkForBranchClosures
methods.description: Checks if an accounting closure has occurred for the specified branch after the provided transaction date; throws an exception if closure date is on or after the transaction date.

methods.name: createDebitJournalEntryOrReversalForInvestor
methods.description: Creates a debit or reversal journal entry for an investor related to a specific loan product and transaction details.

methods.name: createCreditJournalEntryOrReversalForInvestor
methods.description: Creates a credit or reversal journal entry for an investor related to a specific loan ID and transaction details.

methods.name: getChargeOffMappingByCodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves the account mapping for a charge-off reason based on loan product, product type, and charge-off reason ID.

methods.name: getLinkedGLAccountForLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the linked General Ledger account for a loan product based on account mapping type, either organization account or product-specific account.
